messages:
maya-ux: quick sync 11 thinking about a condensed 'compact details' mode in the playground run history for structured outputs. aim: show function calls + key params on one line when possible.

eli-devex: 👍 per-user toggle is fine. question: do we allow collapsing nested objects inline or move them to a flyout?

sam-frontend: prefer inline collapse with a chevron to expand to a small flyout. keeps scanability. accessibility note: ensure chevron is keyboard-focusable.

rachit-ml: for tool-calls show function name and param count (e.g., fetch_user(3)). collapse long strings behind a teaser and a 'View all' action. surface schema mismatches with a subtle warning icon.

zoe-qa: QA checklist: 1) keyboard nav between rows, 2) screen reader reads "Run <id>, collapsed, function fetch_user, params 3", 3) focus trap in flyout. I can validate this.

maya-ux: copy tweak: use 'View details' for the action (aria-label: "View details for run <run id>"). layout note: keep latency and model chip always visible.

eli-devex: emit metric `ui.playground.compact_mode.toggled`. also keep tap targets >=40px.

sam-frontend: i'll make a tiny prototype in storybook and post link.

maya-ux: thanks all 11 will update Figma and circle back with mocks.
